Chargers vs Raiders Betting History

The Los Angeles Chargers and Las Vegas Raiders have met 121 times since the 1966 season. The Raiders lead the series 67-52-2. Against the closing spread the Chargers are 65-54-1 (Raiders 54-65-1), and the over is 41-51-2 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Sep 20, 2026, Raiders 26-14.
